name: is-worker
description: Builds apps and features cheaply: Claude writes the novel core, IndicStack's Qwen writes every family of sibling files from one example, scripts test every file. Runs automatically for builds of ~15 KB+ (or /is-worker). Ends with a token table against a measured frontier-alone build. Includes a built-in token economizer (from microsoft/TokenEconomizer, Apache-2.0; needs Python 3.10+) that stays off until a repository has 5 sessions of history, learning from transcripts meanwhile.
